_doc: Per-brand overrides for the ntn engine. Keys are lowercase brand names and OVERRIDE built-in behavior. Fields (all optional): mode = "exec" for stdin-driven ssh -T brands (default is interactive PTY); paging = pager-disabling command ("" = none); secret_cmd = privilege command ("" = none); config_enter / config_leave = enter/leave config mode; save_lines = array of lines sent after the script ([] = no save); save_delay = seconds per save line; config_show = full config pull command; config_supported = "false" marks a brand with no config model (exec/sync only, config apply refused); hostname_show = hostname pull command; hostname_field = hostname|sysname|host-name|colon|bare (bare = first non-empty output line); err_pattern = grep -E pattern for device errors; negate_prefix = rollback_gen negation prefix without trailing space (no|undo|delete|...). Built-in brands: cisco, huawei, aruba, arista, ruijie, juniper, mikrotik, fortinet, linux, windows. Unknown brands without a profile get generic Cisco-like defaults and skip the save step (running-config only).

linux._doc: Linux server over SSH — exec-mode (stdin-driven ssh -T). No config model: sync snapshots system info, config apply is refused by the engine. Use exec for read-only commands.
linux.err_pattern: (^bash:|^sh:|command not found|Permission denied|No such file or directory)

windows._doc: Windows host over OpenSSH (default shell cmd.exe) — exec-arg mode (each batch as one ssh exec request joined with &; a shell request without PTY is reset by Windows OpenSSH). No config model: sync snapshots systeminfo, config apply is refused by the engine. Use exec for read-only commands.
windows.err_pattern: (is not recognized|Access is denied|The system cannot find)

zte._doc: EXAMPLE profile — ZXR10 is Cisco-like; adjust to your ZTE model/firmware.
